A Rebel '''mission''' to [[Foundry/Legends|Foundry]] with the objective to steal the ''[[Staraker]]'', a brand new assault craft the Empire had been producing, resulted in a small skirmish fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Lead-up==
[[Mici Shabandar]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] were already stationed on Foundry when Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] attempted to infiltrate the starship manufacturing facility.

==The battle==
When passing a checkpoint, Mici and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were found out as [[Spy/Legends|spies]] and a battle soon erupted. Luke and Leia joined in while the Stormtroopers were distracted. They were soon cornered at the launch bay and made a run for it. In the hangar, everyone boarded the ''Staraker''. Leia held off the Stormtroopers when she was hit by a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[bolt]]. She was then carried aboard by Mici. The strike team made it out of Foundry, blasting their way out of the hangar and entering [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] before the nearby fleet elements could react.

==Aftermath==
While in [[Realspace/Legends|space]], the crew got a transmission from [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] who informed them that since they were close to the [[Alashan system/Legends|Alashan system]], they were asked to go and investigate several mysterious disappearances on [[Alashan]].
